head_coach.name: Hugo Broos
head_coach.play_style_summary: Direct and vertical play style focused on rapid transition from defense to offense, utilising quick wing play and a compact midfield block to apply high pressure.

key_players.name: Lyle Foster
key_players.performance_stats: Played 26 league matches for Burnley in the 2025/26 season, registering 1,371 minutes. He excels in physical duels, space exploitation, and holds a high pressing rate.

key_players.name: Relebohile Mofokeng
key_players.performance_stats: Named the Transfermarkt Player of the Season for the 2025/26 Betway Premiership, registering 18 goal contributions. Known for exceptional dribbling, creative key passes, and agility on the flanks.

key_players.name: Teboho Mokoena
key_players.performance_stats: Midfield engine who started 23 league matches for Mamelodi Sundowns in 2025/26. Boasts high pass completion rate, excellent ball recovery, and strong defensive tackles.
